name: Payment
description: A Payment records a customer payment in QuickBooks that can be applied against multiple Invoices and Credit Memos, or created unapplied (recorded as a credit) by specifying only an amount.

update.note: Sparse update; body must include Id and SyncToken.

fields.name: Id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this object. Required for update. Sort order is ASC by default.

fields.name: TotalAmt
fields.description: Indicates the total amount of the transaction, including the total of all charges, allowances, and taxes.

fields.name: CustomerRef
fields.description: Reference to a customer or job. Use Customer.Id and Customer.DisplayName for CustomerRef.value and CustomerRef.name respectively.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Customer.Id of the referenced customer.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The Customer.DisplayName of the referenced customer.

fields.name: SyncToken
fields.description: Version number of the object, used to lock an object for use by one app at a time. Required for update; only the latest version is maintained by QuickBooks Online.

fields.name: CurrencyRef
fields.description: Reference to the currency in which all amounts on the associated transaction are expressed. Conditionally required; must be defined if multicurrency is enabled for the company.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The full name of the currency.

fields.name: ProjectRef
fields.description: Reference to the Project ID associated with this transaction. Conditionally required.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the referenced project.

fields.name: PrivateNote
fields.description: User entered, organization-private note about the transaction.

fields.name: PaymentMethodRef
fields.description: Reference to a PaymentMethod associated with this transaction. Use PaymentMethod.Id and PaymentMethod.Name for PaymentMethodRef.value and PaymentMethodRef.name respectively.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The PaymentMethod.Id of the referenced payment method.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The PaymentMethod.Name of the referenced payment method.

fields.name: UnappliedAmt
fields.description: Indicates the amount that has not been applied to pay amounts owed for sales transactions.

fields.name: DepositToAccountRef
fields.description: Identifies the account to be used for this payment (Account.AccountType is Other Current Asset or Bank). If not specified, payment is applied to the Undeposited Funds account.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Account.Id of the referenced deposit-to account.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The Account.Name of the referenced account.

fields.name: ExchangeRate
fields.description: The number of home currency units it takes to equal one unit of currency specified by CurrencyRef. Applicable if multicurrency is enabled for the company.

fields.name: Line
fields.description: Zero or more transactions accounting for this payment. Line.LinkedTxn.TxnType can be Expense, Check, CreditCardCredit, JournalEntry, CreditMemo, or Invoice.

attributes.name: Amount
attributes.description: The amount of the line, in the home currency.

attributes.name: LinkedTxn
attributes.description: Transactions linked to this payment line.

attributes.name: TxnId
attributes.description: The ID of the linked transaction. Use as the ID in a separate read request for the specific resource.

attributes.name: TxnType
attributes.description: The type of the linked transaction.

attributes.name: LineEx
attributes.description: Internal extension data (name/value pairs such as txnId, txnOpenBalance, txnReferenceNumber).

fields.name: TxnSource
fields.description: Used internally to specify originating source of a credit card transaction.

fields.name: PaymentRefNum
fields.description: The reference number for the payment received. For example, Check # for a check, envelope # for a cash donation.

fields.name: TxnDate
fields.description: The date entered by the user when this transaction occurred. For posting transactions, this is the posting date that affects the financial statements. Defaults to the current server date. Sort order is ASC by default.

fields.name: CreditCardPayment
fields.description: Information about a payment received by credit card. Inject with data only if the payment was transacted through Intuit Payments API.

fields.name: MetaData
fields.description: Descriptive information about the entity. The MetaData values are set by Data Services and are read only for all applications.

attributes.name: CreateTime
attributes.description: Time the entity was created in the source domain.

attributes.name: LastUpdatedTime
attributes.description: Time the entity was last updated in the source domain.

fields.name: TaxExemptionRef
fields.description: Reference to the TaxExemption ID associated with this object. Available for companies that have automated sales tax enabled. For internal use only.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The system-generated Id of the exemption type.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The Tax Exemption Id for the customer, typically issued by the state.

specialOperations.name: Void a payment
specialOperations.description: Voids an existing Payment object via a sparse update, leaving the transaction active but zeroing all amounts/quantities and prepending 'Voided' to PrivateNote.

queryParams.name: operation
queryParams.description: Must be set to 'update' to perform the void via sparse update.

queryParams.name: include
queryParams.description: Must be set to 'void' to void the payment.

specialOperations.note: POST with operation=update&include=void query params; request body must be a sparse update including Payment.Id, Payment.SyncToken, and sparse=true. If funds were deposited, the associated deposit object must be deleted before voiding.

specialOperations.name: Get a payment as PDF
specialOperations.description: Returns the specified Payment object as an Adobe PDF file formatted according to the company's custom form styles.

pathParams.name: paymentId
pathParams.description: The ID of the Payment object to retrieve as PDF.

specialOperations.note: Returns binary PDF content (application/pdf) rather than JSON.

specialOperations.name: Send a payment
specialOperations.description: Emails the specified Payment to the explicitly provided email address and returns the Payment response body.

queryParams.name: sendTo
queryParams.description: The explicit email address to send the payment to; must be specified in the POST request.

pathParams.name: paymentId
pathParams.description: The ID of the Payment object to send.

specialOperations.note: Doc lists only the explicit-email-address variant (POST with sendTo query param); the email address should be explicitly mentioned in the POST request.
